decisions.quote:
The shape of the output response to these narrative tax shocks appears fairly
robust to our tests. In general we find these results to be fairly robust.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly judge Cloyne's (2013) findings to be fairly robust overall across their alternative specifications. Where estimates lose statistical significance—mainly under truncated exogenous-shock lag lengths (q = 4) or aggressive dfbeta outlier exclusions—the authors explicitly deem those specifications biased or less reasonable rather than substantive robustness challenges.
